introduction: Utah’s Family Employment Program combines temporary cash help with employment support. Eligibility and employment counseling are handled by different workers.
description: Utah’s Family Employment Program combines temporary cash help with employment support. Eligibility and employment counseling are handled by different workers.

sections.who: DWS reviews family composition, finances and program requirements. Tell the counselor if two parents who can work live in the home so the correct route is considered.
sections.get: Temporary cash assistance and employment support for an eligible family.
sections.docs:
• Household-member information.
  • Income and citizenship verification requested by DWS.
  • Records of cash assistance received in another state.
sections.apply:
1. Submit intake

    Apply via myCase or a DWS employment center.

  2. Work with eligibility

    Return the listed financial and family verification.

  3. Meet the counselor

    Discuss employment responsibilities and child-support cooperation, including safety concerns.
sections.after: Keep appointments and respond to both workers. Raise any safety concerns about seeking child support directly with the counselor.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using FEP support and responsibilities, FEP verification, Application methods. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: No. Eligibility and FEP employment counseling have different roles.
The state describes temporary assistance with lifetime limits and program conditions.
What if pursuing child support is unsafe?
DWS asks applicants to tell the employment counselor about safety concerns.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
